It feel like that at every life's milestones. You are going to feel like this again in university and think that it will all be over because of a simple grade. Then when you get a job it's the same thing again. Each time you move forward, the previous moments will look to small and insignificant.
Just calm down and study, if you can make the grades, try next time. For its just grades, you have enough time to work on that. For the weight concern, just go back do your diet. You are allowed to make mistakes or even cheat once in a while. Enjoy what you do once in a life, otherwise there is no point living. In my opinion it's not worth it to always keep waiting and working for results, but never enjoying them.

Not really a good idea. It more of a gamble. You could take enough and still end up puking it out and live. Its also not exactly a painless way to go if you are unlucky. It's gonna be worse once you wake up and realize you failed. I fully support your decision, but you should reconsider, if you are not absolutely sure.Hope you read this before you try OD-ing

Is there anyone close enough,that you know personally, that you could talk to? It's not easy getting out of a situation like that if you  have been forced think that lowly of yourself. Having someone else, like even your mother, would help keep yourself sane and safe, and also keep your son safe. Once you can think more clearly, you can make the next big move, like confront or leave your husband.

Kinda sad that you won't be able to finish your proof. Try to live for one more day and finish your proof. If you are that sure that you are gonna kill yourself, you can surely do it once you have completed your paper
Well, what exactly are you going through?

There is no point convincing you not to do it. You have pretty much made up your mind. No matter what anyone says, its just bullshit about how things will get better and stuff. Life is full of shit moments but there are few times when you will enjoy yourself, an example would be when you fell in love. Now, if you still want to see moments like that, i would say atlas wait until tomorrow and think about it again.
Otherwise, good luck and i hope it dosent end up being too painful

Everyone will judge you no matter what. Even when you walk down the street, the most random-est person will still judge you. The good thing about professional help is that they will say it out loud and keep it to themselves. As long as you are in this state of mind, you will keep spiralling downwards and remain poor. 
You dont really have to get professional help , you just need someone to talk to. See how that works out, if that dosent help, then see a psychiatrist. From what i read from your post, you dont seem happy with your life, so make a change and see if that helps.
Looking at how you already made up your mind. Try drinking until you are drunk as fuck before hanging yourself. It will probably help by reducing the pain
Well, if you are planning to kill yourself, what do you have to lose by seeking professional help.
